Maria: PTAL — I've addressed the review comments from @kevin and @olivia, added a small rollback guard and a smoke test script. Summary of changes:
- Fix nil panic in kv allocator
- Add feature flag rollout + guard
- One-line changelog entry
- Smoke script at ./scripts/smoke.sh
I'll plan to merge tomorrow 2024-08-12 09:30 PT unless a hard hold is requested. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/987

Kevin: Quick skim looks good. One small nit: switch that log from warn -> debug. Also please paste the smoke run command here.

Maria: Done — changed to debug and added changelog. Smoke command:
```bash
./scripts/smoke.sh --env=staging --timeout=600
```
Pushed as force-push (branch: fix/kv-alloc-guard).

Olivia: Running smoke now in staging, will report back in ~10m.

CI-Bot: CI passed — unit tests and e2e smoke job cleared. (build: #4821)

Olivia: Smoke completed: basic traffic + ingest checks passed. Saw one connection-pool warning in logs, not related to this change. :thumbsup:

Sam: Happy to take merge ops. Do we want a canary window? I can watch the rollout.

Kevin: I left the inline comment resolved — approve from me once you rebase onto main. PTAL for the rebase.

Maria: Rebasing now, will push in a minute. Thanks @kevin.

Maria: Rebased and pushed. Force-pushed branch -> PR updated.

Kevin: Approved. :white_check_mark:

Maria: Thanks! Scheduling merge for tomorrow 2024-08-12 09:30 PT. Assigning @sam for merge ops and initial canary watch (first 20m). If anyone needs hold or earlier merge, say so now.

Sam: I'll be ready. I'll also run `kubectl rollout status` and smoke curl checks post-merge.

Maria: Appreciate it — will do squash merge at that time and add release note under releases/notes.

Olivia: echoing :+1: good to go from my side.
